mapper.select: SELECT office_code as value, office_name as label FROM js_sys_office WHERE zip_code IS NOT NULL
SELECT MIN(id) as value, position_name as label FROM fms_position_archive WHERE type = 'CJ' GROUP BY position_name
SELECT MIN(id) as value, prod_line_name as label FROM fms_prod_line GROUP BY prod_line_name
SELECT MIN(id) as value, work_group_name as label FROM fms_work_group GROUP BY work_group_name
SELECT DISTINCT work_type as value, work_type as label FROM fms_worker WHERE work_type IS NOT NULL AND work_type != ''
SELECT office_code FROM js_sys_office WHERE office_name = #{companyName} AND zip_code IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT id FROM fms_position_archive WHERE position_name = #{departmentName} AND type = 'CJ'
AND status = '0' AND region = #{companyId} LIMIT 1
SELECT work_type FROM fms_worker WHERE work_type = #{workTypeName} AND work_type IS NOT NULL AND work_type != '' LIMIT 1
SELECT dict_value FROM swm_dict_data WHERE dict_type = 'person_type_enum' AND dict_label = #{personTypeName} AND status = '0' LIMIT 1
